1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 30 cm de longitud, con bandas alternas de color amarillo y azul, reflejos plateados en el cuerpo y dos bandas negras, las aletas de color amarillo; su carne es apreciada. Haemulidae, Anisotremus virginicus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 30 cm in length, with alternating bands of yellow and blue coloration, silver reflections on the body, and two black bands; its fins are yellow; its flesh is prized. Family Haemulidae, Anisotremus virginicus.
